## Signature
`agent-harvest-wikidata`

## Root cause
The run failed with signature Agent harvest Wikidata.

## Structural fix
Change the producer so this signature cannot recur: one output file per shard, schema_version on the contract, and a regression test. Do not rerun the job.

One issue per signature. If ROOT_CAUSES.md already describes this cause, close this issue.
